The Original Amy Winehouse Band live in Athens - Παρασκευή 13 Φεβρουαρίου 2026 Gazarte

Παρασκευή 13 Φεβρουαρίου στις 20:00 | Gazarte

The horn section hits that first note and you're back in 2006. You're standing in Gazarte, surrounded by people who remember where they were when they first heard Amy Winehouse. The stage holds musicians who were actually there, who played those records, who created that sound. This is tribute, but it's also testimony.

The Original Amy Winehouse Band brings something no other tribute can offer: authenticity. These are the musicians who recorded "Back to Black," who toured the world with Winehouse during her years of impossible brilliance. Dale Davis on bass, Nathan Allen on drums, Zalon Thompson providing vocals that honor without imitating. They're not recreating something they studied; they're performing music they helped create.

Winehouse's death left a particular hole in music. She'd revived an entire sound, bringing jazz and soul back into pop consciousness with an urgency that couldn't be manufactured. The songs from "Frank" and "Back to Black" have aged into classics, their quality becoming clearer as time passes. Hearing them performed by her original band creates an experience beyond normal tribute.

Gazarte provides the appropriate venue. The Main Stage holds enough capacity for the event to feel like an occasion while maintaining the intimacy the music requires. The Gazi location adds its own layer, the industrial neighborhood complementing music that never pretended to be pretty.

The crowd tonight spans generations and motivations. Some were there during Winehouse's lifetime, at the London shows, at the European festivals. Others discovered the music after her death, inheriting it as historical artifact. What unites them is the songs themselves, material that transcends its moment.

The band approaches the material with the respect of people who understood Winehouse personally, not just musically. Between songs, they share stories that haven't been published, observations about how she worked, why certain arrangements took the forms they did. The evening becomes part concert, part memorial, part musical archaeology.

If you need updated arrangements and contemporary production, this evening won't provide them. The Original Amy Winehouse Band plays the music as it was recorded, honoring the originals. But if you're ready to hear those songs performed by the people who invented them, to experience the sound of "Back to Black" as it was meant to be heard, you find your way to Gazi.
